ar-06ge.title: Sign: yellow junction sign with chevrons at bottom
ar-06ge.summary: At T-junctions in one central-south province, a yellow rectangular sign with a chevron pattern at the bottom, road numbers above and an arrow on each side.

ar-2AHH.title: Plants: rows of tall thin poplars on flat land
ar-2AHH.summary: Single rows of thin, tall poplar trees are very common around one Patagonian-edge region, and the area is very flat.

ar-2ZIl.title: Plants: candelabra cactus with golden fuzzy spines
ar-2ZIl.summary: The cardon is a candelabra-shaped cactus with fuzzy golden-brown spines, native to the high mountains of the north-west.

ar-46I8.title: Landscape: red soil in the north-east tip
ar-46I8.summary: Red soil is typical of the far north-east province. Brazil looks similar there, so look for other clues first.

differs.how: Looks similar in this region, check other clues

ar-63ID.title: Coverage: horse-mounted camera in the south-west
ar-63ID.summary: A camera carried on a horse is found in the south-west of a western province. A similar one exists on the Chilean side.

ar-6o3V.title: Plants: compact fan palm with dead-leaf trunk coat
ar-6o3V.summary: A hardy palm with compact fan-like leaves and a trunk hidden by a coat of dead leaves. Native to central hills, spreading to the west and north mountains.

ar-97t1.title: Pole: round concrete, 3 lines alternating, often doubled
ar-97t1.summary: Round concrete poles with three wires in an alternating pattern are very common. Doubled-up poles are a good clue. Bolivia occasionally has similar doubled concrete poles.

ar-9ggu.title: Road: winding dirt road up in the clouds
ar-9ggu.summary: The western part of RN65 in the north-west is a bendy unpaved mountain road, with its west end up in the clouds.

ar-BMCC.title: Landscape: vineyards, mountains west, flat east
ar-BMCC.summary: Vineyards with mountains to the west and flat land to the east mean you are likely in the outskirts of the best-known wine region.

ar-BOTl.title: Landscape: flat and barren, central south
ar-BOTl.summary: Flat, barren land like this is typical of the central south.

ar-Bb04.title: Landscape: flat, treeless, empty and wide open
ar-Bb04.summary: Most of the country is fairly flat, nearly treeless and thinly populated. With no better clue, a wide open, desolate landscape like this points here.

ar-BjEa.title: Plants: low-density forests of short fan-leaf palms
ar-BjEa.summary: These palms (Caranday wax palm) have short fan-like leaves and grow in thin, single-species forests. Most common in the north-east, also in nearby provinces.

ar-DZIL.title: Crops: corn across the north
ar-DZIL.summary: Corn grows in most of the north, most commonly in the centre and north-centre.

ar-Gsxd.title: Landscape: volcanic rocks in Gen 4, high plateau
ar-Gsxd.summary: These volcanic rocks in Gen 4 coverage appear only on RP43 south of a high-altitude village in the north-west.

ar-GzEE.title: Chevron: white-and-red
ar-GzEE.summary: Chevrons are usually white and red. No other American country uses them.

ar-HSWC.title: Plants: beech forests in the far south
ar-HSWC.summary: Beech forests are common in the far-south island province.

ar-HidJ.title: Plants: pampas grass with white fluffy flowers
ar-HidJ.summary: Pampas grass has long bunched reeds and white fluffy flowerheads. It is typical of the central plains.

ar-IHvK.title: Marker: white km post with black strip on top
ar-IHvK.summary: White kilometre markers with a black strip showing the road number at the top. RN means national road (white on the map) and RP provincial (green on the map).

ar-IIWE.title: Landscape: snowy mountains to the north of a southern city
ar-IIWE.summary: Snowy mountains lie to the north of the southernmost city, the island province capital. They are found only there.

ar-Ipth.title: Landscape: lower hills west of a central city
ar-Ipth.summary: These mountains are typical west of a central city. They are not as high as the mountains along the western border.

ar-IrVr.title: Plants: tree plantations in the north-east
ar-IrVr.summary: Most tree plantations are in the north-east river province. Uruguay and southern Brazil have them too, so check other clues.

differs.how: Also has tree plantations, check other clues

ar-KCJo.title: Landscape: red soil, barren, mountain ranges
ar-KCJo.summary: Red soil, barren land and mountain ranges, often seen on RN76 in a national park in the west.

ar-KgOC.title: Landscape: small lakes next to the road
ar-KgOC.summary: Small lakes beside the road show up now and then in the big central-east province.

ar-KkRF.title: Landscape: grassland with a few tree plantations
ar-KkRF.summary: Grassland with a few separate tree plantations is typical of this area.

ar-MNox.title: Plants: monkey puzzle trees in the west
ar-MNox.summary: Monkey puzzle trees grow in the west of a Patagonian province, with the most along road 23. They also grow on the Chilean side.

ar-NUPv.title: Pole: single insulator on the side
ar-NUPv.summary: In one western wine province, poles have a single insulator attached to the side.

ar-RNbN.title: Plate: black with black dot, or white with blue bar
ar-RNbN.summary: Two plate types: black with a black dot in the middle, or white with a blue bar on top. The black dot exists only here, but Brazil also has the blue bar.

differs.how: Has the blue bar but never the black dot

ar-UvI1.title: Landscape: grassy hills near the coast
ar-UvI1.summary: Grassy semi-coastal hills in the south of the big central-east province, especially north-east of its southern port.

ar-UzNb.title: Google car: black back covered in sandy dust
ar-UzNb.summary: The sawdust car is in the central south and has a unique sandy dust on its visible black back.

ar-VRyU.title: Vehicles: unique taxi designs in several cities
ar-VRyU.summary: Several big cities each have their own recognisable taxi design.

ar-VfW1.title: Landscape: mountains in the far west
ar-VfW1.summary: The far west is mountainous. Mountains are rare in the east.

ar-WFi2.title: Plants: flat grass and few bushes in the far south
ar-WFi2.summary: Flat grass with few bushes means you are almost certainly in the far-south island province or the south-east of the next province up.

ar-XFL6.title: Pole: wooden hook poles with alternating insulators
ar-XFL6.summary: Wooden poles with hook-shaped insulators, like those in Latvia. Within the country, only in two western provinces.

ar-Z4q5.title: Crops: sorghum with dark red heads
ar-Z4q5.summary: Sorghum fields, with dark red flowerheads, are most common in the central-east provinces.

ar-bekw.title: Guardrail: yellow and red rectangular reflectors
ar-bekw.summary: Guardrails often carry yellow and red rectangular reflectors. Uruguay has them too, but its guardrail supports have a different shape.

ar-cc7y.title: Plants: palm with thin leaves, spear top, smooth trunk
ar-cc7y.summary: A palm with small thin leaves, a spear-shaped top and a smooth trunk. Planted for decoration everywhere, but wild mostly in the north-east.

ar-cqF0.title: Plants: wild sunflowers in the north-west
ar-cqF0.summary: Wild sunflowers are often found in the three north-west provinces.

ar-eF4M.title: Google car: Gen 3 black car
ar-eF4M.summary: Gen 3 coverage shows a black car. In South America only Peru and Uruguay also have a black car.

ar-fKN6.title: Road lines: dashed white, double yellow or mixed
ar-fKN6.summary: Road lines are mainly dashed white, double yellow, or a mix.

ar-fwgj.title: Plants: large deciduous tree with twisty branches
ar-fwgj.summary: A fairly large deciduous tree with small leaves and twisting branches, mostly in the central-south plains. It can be confused with other carob-type trees.

ar-fy4M.title: Landscape: sandy soil with low trees and bushes
ar-fy4M.summary: In the north, sandy soil covered in low trees and bushes.

ar-i6k7.title: Pole: white vertical sticker with digits
ar-i6k7.summary: White vertical pole stickers with several digits are found in one north-west province.

ar-jAh5.title: Google car: Gen 4 smallcam, low with big blur
ar-jAh5.summary: A Gen 4 camera mounted lower than normal, with a big round blur and a small bump at the front. Only Peru, Brazil and one other South American country have it.

ar-jKU1.title: Marker: unique markers on provincial roads
ar-jKU1.summary: Distinctive markers appear on the provincial roads of one central province.

ar-knP3.title: Landscape: red mountains along a valley road
ar-knP3.summary: These red mountains are unique to the valley of the RN68 road in the south of a north-west province.

ar-kujK.title: Houses: red bricks in the north-west, like Bolivia
ar-kujK.summary: Red bricks, like the common ones in Bolivia, appear in the north-west, especially the far west of the northern province.

ar-lP62.title: Houses: quartzite facades, orange tiles, vault porches
ar-lP62.summary: In a coastal resort city and nearby towns: houses with quartzite stone facades, orange tiled roofs, attached garages and vault-shaped porches.

ar-lm-157.title: Marker: black-and-white highway markers
ar-lm-157.summary: Black-and-white highway markers are a good sign you are in this country.

ar-lm-278.title: Pole: double round concrete poles joined by a ring
ar-lm-278.summary: Two round concrete poles connected by a concrete ring are almost exclusive to this country. Bolivia has similar ones only occasionally, with very different scenery.

differs.how: Only occasionally, with very different scenery

ar-lm-280.title: Landscape: flat, empty land with black car back
ar-lm-280.summary: A flat, desolate, treeless, thinly populated area with the black back of the Google car points here. Jordan can look similar and also has a black car back.

differs.how: Similar landscape and black car, but different other clues

ar-lm-3646.title: Coverage: thick mist on a mountain road
ar-lm-3646.summary: On route 65 in the north-west, heading west, the car drives through mist so thick it blocks the view.

ar-lm-3888.title: Coverage: glitchy colours from an early start
ar-lm-3888.summary: In the north of a Patagonian province, the camera produced glitchy colours at sunrise. They fade going north and look normal by the province border.

ar-lm-465032.title: Phone numbers: 10 digits, first 3-4 are regional
ar-lm-465032.summary: Phone numbers have 10 digits. The first 3 or 4 digits are the regional code, only 2 for the capital.

ar-lm-486304.title: Pole: type B, vertical bar stops at top bar
ar-lm-486304.summary: A B-type pole where the vertical bar ends at the top horizontal bar instead of sticking out above it.

ar-lm-486305.title: Pole: type B, vertical bar sticks out a medium length
ar-lm-486305.summary: A B-type pole where the vertical beam extends above the top horizontal bar by about the gap between the two horizontal bars.

ar-lm-486306.title: Pole: type B, wooden
ar-lm-486306.summary: A wooden version of the B-type pole.

ar-lm-486307.title: Pole: type B with cap, down-facing insulators
ar-lm-486307.summary: A B-type pole with a cap on top: a lower bar with two sets of insulators pointing down, and a one-sided bar above it with more down-pointing insulators.

ar-lm-486308.title: Pole: type B, short top
ar-lm-486308.summary: A B-type pole where the vertical bar sticks out only slightly above the top bar, less than the gap between the horizontal bars.

ar-lm-486309.title: Pole: type B with up-facing insulators
ar-lm-486309.summary: A B-type pole with a lower bar of two insulator sets pointing up and a one-sided bar above with more up-pointing insulators.

ar-lm-486311.title: Pole: type C, short cap on top
ar-lm-486311.summary: A C-type pole where the vertical beam extends above the top horizontal bar by less than the gap between the other bars.

ar-lm-486312.title: Pole: type C, three alternating bars, no cap
ar-lm-486312.summary: A C-type pole with 3 alternating horizontal beams, each with down-facing insulators at the end, and no cap on top.

ar-lm-486313.title: Pole: type D, only one top bar with unusual shape
ar-lm-486313.summary: A D-type pole has no horizontal beams except the one on top, which has a shape unlike other poles here. Found everywhere but rarer in some regions.

ar-lm-617590.title: Plants: single-row poplars, hills, vineyards, olives
ar-lm-617590.summary: Tall thin poplars grow all over, but single rows with hilly Mediterranean scenery, vineyards, olives, palms and plane trees mean a town in the two western wine provinces.

ar-lm-617594.title: Plants: light-green cushion plants in Patagonia
ar-lm-617594.summary: Cushion-like plants that are found all across Patagonia. In a distinctive light green they appear in the south of one province, on certain roads in the next province, and in the middle and south of the next one.

ar-lm-617595.title: Plants: single-row poplars on very flat land
ar-lm-617595.summary: Single rows of poplars with a very flat landscape point to certain places: route 22 between two river-valley towns, and two towns in the south-east Patagonian province.

ar-lm-617596.title: Plants: dense, very red grass in the far south
ar-lm-617596.summary: A grass with a very red hue. In dense stands it appears at the far southern end south of the southernmost mainland city, on route 40 in the far south, and on route 40 in the south-west.

ar-lm-617597.title: Plants: red-tinged grass across the south
ar-lm-617597.summary: The red grass is found in the west and south of the far-south province, the north-west of the next province up, and the south of a Patagonian-edge province.

ar-lm-7343.title: Vehicles: black taxi with yellow roof top only
ar-lm-7343.summary: A taxi with a black body and only the top of the roof yellow. Rosario and the capital have different taxis.

ar-lm-7344.title: Vehicles: red taxi with black stripe
ar-lm-7344.summary: Red taxis with a black stripe are unique to one north-west city.

ar-lm-7345.title: Vehicles: all green or all yellow taxi with oval
ar-lm-7345.summary: All-green or all-yellow taxis with an oval shape under the driver's door are unique to one central city.

ar-lm-7347.title: Vehicles: white taxi with yellow roof
ar-lm-7347.summary: White taxis with a yellow roof are unique to one western province.

ar-lm-7348.title: Vehicles: black and yellow taxi, body only partly black
ar-lm-7348.summary: This black and yellow taxi is unique to one wine province. Other cities have black-and-yellow taxis, but with a completely black body.

ar-lm-7349.title: Vehicles: white taxi with blue roof and logo
ar-lm-7349.summary: A taxi with a white body, blue roof and blue logo is unique to one Andean lake city.

ar-lm-7350.title: Vehicles: old white taxi, yellow-black checker stripe
ar-lm-7350.summary: Old-style white taxis with a yellow-and-black checkerboard stripe are unique to one north-west city.

ar-lm-7351.title: Vehicles: taxi with red-white-green stripe
ar-lm-7351.summary: Taxis with a red, white and green stripe (like the Hungarian flag) are unique to one northern city.

ar-lm-7352.title: Vehicles: white taxi with light-green roof
ar-lm-7352.summary: White taxis with light-green roofs are unique to one northern city.

ar-lm-7353.title: Vehicles: black taxi, yellow roof, black middle bar
ar-lm-7353.summary: A black body with a yellow roof. The outer roof bars are yellow and the middle bar behind the driver is black, unlike the capital and one north-west city.

ar-lm-7354.title: Vehicles: black taxi, yellow roof, painted middle bar
ar-lm-7354.summary: Black body and yellow roof, like in two other cities, but here the middle roof bar behind the driver is painted too. Only the capital does that.

ar-lm-7355.title: Vehicles: white taxi with two light-blue stripes
ar-lm-7355.summary: White taxis with two light-blue stripes, like the national flag, are unique to one central province.

ar-lm-7356.title: Vehicles: all-yellow taxi, no door logos
ar-lm-7356.summary: All-yellow taxis. Unlike another city's yellow taxis, their doors have no logos or paintings.

ar-lm-7357.title: Vehicles: white taxi with green parts
ar-lm-7357.summary: White taxis with green elements are typical of one big city near the capital.

ar-lm-7358.title: Vehicles: all-white taxi with black logo
ar-lm-7358.summary: An all-white taxi with a black logo is unique to one southern coastal city.

ar-lm-7389.title: Plants: pink trumpet trees in northern towns
ar-lm-7389.summary: Pink trumpet trees, covered in pink blossoms, grow in towns of the far north of a north-west province.

ar-lm-7400.title: Coverage: low-quality sunset footage on a long road
ar-lm-7400.summary: Dark, degraded sunset footage on RN40 just south of the border between two western provinces.

ar-lm-7401.title: Coverage: low-quality sunrise footage with several blurs
ar-lm-7401.summary: Sunrise footage with bad quality and several blurs on a short part of RN251 and RN22, west of a river town.

ar-lm-7405.title: Coverage: snow on the ground on a south-east road
ar-lm-7405.summary: Snow-covered coverage on the eastern part of RP25 in the east of the far-south province.

ar-lm-7407.title: Road: dark red dirt, dark cloudy, like Mars
ar-lm-7407.summary: RP1 in the Patagonian-edge province is a dark red dirt road with dark, cloudy coverage that looks like Mars. It spills onto RP7 in the north and RP10 in the south.

ar-lm-7408.title: Landscape: dam among rock formations
ar-lm-7408.summary: A unique dam surrounded by the same rock formations as the village east of it, found west of that town.

ar-muxx.title: Plants: tall tree-like cactus with toothpick spines
ar-muxx.summary: A big tree-like cactus with many branches and spines like toothpicks. Found around a spot in the north-west centre and on the northern border area.

ar-mwYE.title: Landscape: salt flats in the far north-west
ar-mwYE.summary: Salt pans are typically in the far north-west province. They also appear in south-west Bolivia and north-east Chile.

ar-ouvs.title: Pole: wooden poles, A-frame only here in South America
ar-ouvs.summary: Wooden poles are fairly common, with or without a crossbar. Wooden A-frame poles in South America exist only here.

ar-ozI4.title: Plants: arching feathery palms, leaning, mixed heights
ar-ozI4.summary: A palm with arching, feather-like leaves that often leans and varies in height. Most common in the north-east and one national park in the east.

ar-r2iz.title: Crops: sunflower fields in the south of the north
ar-r2iz.summary: Sunflower fields are mainly in the south of the northern chaco region, and less often in the central east and south of the centre.

ar-tuz2.title: Coverage: melting snow near the western border
ar-tuz2.summary: Melting snow coverage appears on the eastern part of RN293 near the Chilean border in the far south-west.

ar-uYP9.title: Crops: sugarcane in the north-west
ar-uYP9.summary: Sugarcane plantations are most common in the north-west, with hotspots in two nearby provinces.

ar-vOS7.title: Landscape: rock formations around a dam town
ar-vOS7.summary: A village in the north-east of a Patagonian province is surrounded by rock formations. Sometimes a dam is visible to the west.

ar-wj6M.title: Landscape: city built on hill slopes
ar-wj6M.summary: A coastal city is built on the slopes of a hill, which makes it recognisable.

ar-xvu6.title: Road: reddish pavement lined with long tussock grass
ar-xvu6.summary: Roads with reddish tarmac lined with long needle-grass are common in one central-west province.
